meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 接入 Signal 频道:通过 signal-cli 把你现有手机作为「关联设备」绑定,助手就用该号码收发消息,不需要新号码或机器人 API。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Signal、让助手用你的手机号收发消息时,通常在 /setup 流程中或之后运行。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 绑到我的 Signal 账号,用手机扫码关联设备。
say.note: 会打印二维码和 sgnl:// 链接,扫一次完成关联。

say.text: 改用独立号码注册 Signal,再收验证码。
say.note: 要先过 captcha,再等约 60 秒请求语音验证。

say.text: 给这个 Signal 用户开通访问权限,角色设为 owner。

howto.what_en: Adds a Signal channel to NanoClaw via a native adapter that speaks JSON-RPC to a signal-cli daemon. Links as a secondary device on your existing phone, so the assistant sends and receives as that number.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add Signal as a channel so the assistant reaches you over Signal, typically during or after the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Link NanoClaw to my Signal account by device-link QR.
say_en.note: Prints a QR and a sgnl:// link to scan once.

say_en.text: Register a dedicated Signal number instead of linking.
say_en.note: Needs a captcha, then SMS and voice verification.

say_en.text: Grant this Signal user access as owner.
say_en.note: New Signal senders are dropped until granted.
